title: Orientation & Access Setup
tasks: Collect company laptop, phone, and standard tool bag.
Complete HR onboarding and McDonald's IT security awareness training.
Set up credentials for Meraki Dashboard, ServiceNow, and VNC Manager.
Shadow a Senior Field Engineer for 3 days on routine maintenance calls.
Review the Health and Safety guidelines for kitchen environments.

title: Store Formats & Device Taxonomy
tasks: Memorize the standard naming conventions for all store devices.
Study the differences in IT setup between Drive-Thru, Mall, and Standalone formats.
Complete the Acrelec Kiosk hardware maintenance module.
Learn how to safely replace a KVS monitor over a hot fryer.
Perform a solo site survey to map out network topology of a training store.

title: Basic Ticketing & Site Visits
tasks: Take ownership of low-severity tickets (e.g., Bump Bar replacement, Kiosk paper jams).
Practice configuring a replacement POS Terminal (TC) in the staging lab.
Accompany a technician to resolve a Drive-Thru Headset audio issue.
Learn to pull and analyze logs from a frozen NCR POS terminal.
Conduct a preventive maintenance run on a high-volume store.

title: Network Troubleshooting & Full Autonomy
tasks: Diagnose a simulated network outage on the Delphi test rig.
Use Meraki Dashboard to identify and bounce a failed PoE port.
Handle a mix of medium and high severity tickets independently (with remote backup).
Perform a full NewPOS software upgrade on a lab terminal.
Pass the Field Engineer Readiness Assessment with the IT Manager.
